rows.question: Does this actually solve when you run it? I need the simulator's verdict, not a guess.
rows.answer:
No - it fails immediately. LTspice reports: "Voltage source V2 and voltage source V1 are paralleled making an over-defined circuit matrix."

The fault is that V1 (5 V) and V2 (3 V) both drive net Vout against ground, so two ideal sources contradict each other on the same node and the matrix has no solution. Fix: delete one of them (keep V1 at 5 V if that's the intended supply), or if both are meant to drive the node, put a series resistance in at least one branch so they aren't ideally paralleled.
